messages:
Samira (CS): Heads-up — OrionPay onboarding: baseline p99 latency ~820ms during US morning peak (vs target 450ms). Customer mentioned renewal in 6 weeks, they're worried. I captured logs: shard 3 increased queue depth.
Ethan (Solutions): @Samira curious if this is KV cache warmup or model sim? any recent quant changes?
Samira (CS): No model change on their side. Traffic spike aligned with larger batch of long-context docs. Looks like batch size distribution shifted. :thinking: 
Marco (Platform Eng): Likely sequence-length tail. Two quick knobs: 1) route heavy traffic to a higher-priority Dedicated pool during 08:00-11:00 PT; 2) try int8 quantization profile we validated for this model — reduces GPU memory and kernel time for >2048 tokens.
Ethan (Solutions): Agreed. Suggest a short canary: 10% traffic to quantized variant with automatic fallback. Also a routing policy change: latency-first for their key routes. estimated savings ~22% compute/tokens, p99 improvement ~30-40ms.
Samira (CS): Proposed plan for CS + Eng + Infra:
- Week 0: small canary (10%) with metric tracking
- Week 1: expand to 50% if p99 improved and quality invariant
- Capture 100 representative prompts from OrionPay for evals
- Billing impact + renewal playbook ready
Ethan (Solutions): Canary commands (infra run):
```
redwood route update --customer OrionPay --policy latency-first --window "08:00-11:00 PT"
redwood deploy model:onion-distilled-int8 --canary 10 --monitor metrics:latency,q-error
```
Marco (Platform Eng): Also recommend model swap to distilled variant for long-context workloads — we have a pre-quantized profile 'rwin-distil-int8-v2'. If fallbacks needed, policy should route to the full model in Dedicated.
Samira (CS): CS to schedule enablement call with OrionPay next Tue, collect 20 sample prompts and acceptance criteria. I'll update the renewal risk as 'monitoring' not 'at-risk' if canary goes well.
Ethan (Solutions): I'll set up the eval harness and push the canary tonight 22:00 PT. tagging @ops-bot for alerting.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: model:onion-distilled-int8 canary 10% at 2025-04-12T22:00:00Z — will post status.
Samira (CS): Thanks — I'll prep the renewal note and share the enablement doc link: https://redwood.app/enablement/orionpay-perf-plan :thumbsup: 
Marco (Platform Eng): One more ask — CS, collect two failure cases if quality drops by >0.5 BLEU (or other metric) and we'll rollback automatically.
Samira (CS): Copy. Team — any objections? If not, I'll proceed with calendar invite and tracking doc.
Ethan (Solutions): none from eng.
Marco (Platform Eng): good.
Samira (CS): proceeding. :rocket:
